metadata.author: Antigravity Research Pipeline
metadata.component: Component 3: Regional Electricity Demand Forecasting Subsystem

geographic_scope.scope_name: Ratnapura District, Sabaragamuwa Province, Sri Lanka (CEB Distribution Division 3)
geographic_scope.description: Electricity consumption across the administrative Ratnapura District served under Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) Distribution Division 3 (DD3), encompassing Ratnapura, Kahawatte, Eheliyagoda, Pelmadulla, Balangoda, and Embilipitiya consumer service areas.

ceb_statistical_benchmarks.source_documentation: Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) Statistical Digest (2018-2025) and Sales and Generation Data Books for Sabaragamuwa Province / Distribution Division 3

economic_crisis_load_shedding_2022.description: CEB nationwide rotational load shedding (2 to 13 hours/day) and fuel shortages curtailing demand

sinhala_tamil_new_year.description: Annual Avurudu holidays: major tea estates, gem mining, and commercial operations closure

unverified_assumptions_and_limitations: Actual daily metering data at the consumer service center level is internal to CEB and not publicly accessible.
Ratnapura District share of Sabaragamuwa Province sales is assumed at 63.5% based on demographic and consumer account proportions.
Day-of-week load factors reflect regional tea/rubber factory and commercial schedules but lack sub-hourly feeder telemetry.
